u0: Initial active state: the agent has not yet toggled the wall switch. Its objective is to reach the exit without ever using the switch; any toggle, even if the siren is silent or the action seems harmless, will violate the task. Reaching the exit transitions to success, while avoiding the switch remains the constraint throughout.
u1: Failure sink state: the agent has toggled the wall switch at least once, incurring the violation penalty. The task is already failed and the violation cannot be undone; no further reward can be earned, including by later reaching the exit. The agent remains in this state for the rest of the episode.
u2: Final success state: the agent reached the exit without ever toggling the wall switch and has received the success reward. The task is complete; this terminal state persists if any further transitions are considered.
